gates.name: Input Readiness
gates.description: Approved sources, identifiers and allowed data classification.

gates.name: Output Quality
gates.description: Traceability, duplicates, unsupported behavior and testability reviewed.

gates.name: Publication
gates.description: Qualified human approval and complete evidence retention.

gates.name: Scale
